How to run (only macosx)

svn checkout https://form-follows-function.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/ form-follows-function

cd form-follows-function

ant

cd f3_cg_jogl_awt

./demo.sh

Then drag & drop .svg or .ma (maya ascii)  or .png files on the window.  Switch cameras with the number keys (camera 0 is the free camera). Camera 9 is a 2d camera (cpu rasterizer).
